For visitors

Sign up on Meetup. The ride starts on time. Bring water, a spare tube, tools and a bike in working order. Rides are cancelled in bad weather, so check Meetup first.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Level 4 to 5 (intermediate); no drop. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Front Range Mountain Bikers Monday After-Work Ride group ride

Front Range Mountain Bikers Monday After-Work Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Golden, CO. It rolls every Monday at 5:00 pm from Varies by week. Oct 5: Lair o’ the Bear Park, upper lot, 22550 CO-74, Idledale.

A social, no-drop mountain bike ride after work on Monday, on trails in Jefferson, Boulder, Clear Creek and Douglas counties. Rides carry a level from 1 to 5, and the Mondays run at level 4 or 5. The group often stays for a drink in the parking lot. Oct 5 is two laps of the Rutabaga trail at Lair o’ the Bear, about 12 miles.
